summary: Ashland County, WI tower listed as standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no build date, design, staffing or access details found in the sources read.

evidence.supports: tower is in Ashland County, Wisconsin
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as standing at 46.30079, -90.61747
OpenStreetMap names the tower Mellen Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Forest Lookouts gives only the county, and the FFLA lists it standing without a register number. OSM supplies the name and 571 m elevation, which matches the brief. The brief's agency (null) and access (unknown) remain unchanged. The Wisconsin Historical Society search for Ashland County fire towers did not show a Mellen entry, and the NHLR guessed URL returned 404. A local source (Ashland County or the Wisconsin DNR history) is needed before the story can say when it was built or who staffed it. No photos found.
